questions.stem_text: According to Hobbes, the definition of injustice is _____.

questions.stem_text: Kant claims that the moral law is given to each person by:
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - one's own will.

questions.stem_text: One example of bad constitutive moral luck would be:

options.A: a person who donates to charity regularly.
options.C: a person who lived in Nazi Germany in 1940.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - a person who donates to charity regularly.

questions.stem_text:

Singer think is the least serious?
